title: Exercise library (exercises.json), schema_version 1
description: Optional library giving exercises stable IDs, aliases and muscle groups. See docs/DATA_FORMAT.md. Workout files never require this file to be readable. Uniqueness of ids, previous_ids and normalized names/aliases across entries is checked by the app, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable key. Never change or reuse it; merge via previous_ids instead.

aliases.description: Other names that mean this exercise. Matched after normalization.

previous_ids.description: Retired ids that now resolve to this entry (used when merging duplicates).

includes_bodyweight.description: The lifter's body weight is part of the load (pull-up, dip, push-up). Omitted means false.
